summary: Red-Handed leads through the Red Palace to Lost King, then Lost Queen. Both are required for Lost Colony ascension; the second fight changes from tame combat to an on-foot spear duel.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.
Prepare spare armor, Medical Brews and Blood Packs for the Queen; your tames will be unconscious during her fight.
Assign pole destruction and minion control before the King. Save ammunition and healing for vulnerability windows rather than firing at his airborne mount.

steps.title: 1 · Establish a cold-weather base
steps.reason: Cold protection, supply reserves and transport sustain longer mission routes.

steps.title: 2 · Campaign access
steps.reason: Begin Red-Handed through the Red Terminal and complete the palace objectives. The terminal is the mission approach, not the final boss arena.

steps.title: 3 · Ground Lost King
steps.reason: Destroy the power poles while controlling Thralls. His Gigadesmodus then lands and opens a damage window; nearby exploding crystals can stun him.

steps.title: 4 · Lost Queen and ascension
steps.reason: Tames fall unconscious. Fight on foot with the encounter’s Tek Spear, dodge her attacks and hit the Codex’s blue pulses to interrupt her healing.

loadouts.entry: Prepare pole destruction, add control and damage during landing windows.
loadouts.warning: No numeric army thresholds are verified here. Check current encounter eligibility and your save settings.

options.title: Rex army with courage and healing support

options.play: Destroy poles first. Keep Thralls off the team, then attack the grounded boss; use exploding crystals for stun windows.
options.confidence: Current Wiki encounter guidance; no independently measured ASA minimum stats or guaranteed win.
